title: Online information day: EIC funding opportunities in 2027
summary: A full-day online session walking through the European Innovation Council's 2027 work programme, scheme by scheme.
details: The agenda opens with the main changes in the 2027 work programme, then covers EIC Pathfinder, EIC Transition and the EIC Accelerator, followed by STEP and STEP Defence, the Business Acceleration Services and the Access2EIC and EEN2EIC support networks. It runs from 09:30 to 15:40 CET in English.
Registration closes on 18 November 2026 at 09:30 CET. Questions can be sent in advance through Slido.
why: Start-ups, SMEs and research teams weighing an EIC application should hear the 2027 changes from the agency itself before committing to a scheme. Bring concrete questions on eligibility and fit between Pathfinder, Transition and Accelerator.
